stem: Comparing Morphine and Oxycodone, which statement is true regarding their potency and bioavailability?

options.text: Morphine has a higher oral bioavailability than Oxycodone.
Oxycodone is approximately 1.5 times more potent than Morphine.
Morphine is 2 times stronger than Oxycodone.
Both medications have the same starting dose of $0.5 \text{ mg/kg}$.

explanation: The source states that Oxycodone is slightly stronger, with a potency about 1.5 times that of Morphine.
rationale: Consider which medication requires a lower dose to achieve the same effect.

optionExplanations.A: Morphine has a poor oral bioavailability ($30-40\%$) compared to Oxycodone ($80\%$).
optionExplanations.B: The source states that Oxycodone is slightly stronger, with a potency about 1.5 times that of Morphine.
optionExplanations.C: Oxycodone is actually the more potent of the two medications.
optionExplanations.D: Starting doses differ: Oxycodone starts at $0.1 \text{ mg/kg}$ and Morphine starts at $0.2 \text{ mg/kg}$.

source.hint: Consider which medication requires a lower dose to achieve the same effect.
